15:22 Local Time, 13:22 GMT, 18:52 IST: What is happening? Renshaw and Cummins are walking off the field. Richard Kettleborough is having a word with Bavuma. It has gone very dark and gloomy at Kingsmead. The floodlights have been turned on. But that is not enough for play the continue. The two umpires take the light reading. For now, play is stopped due to bad light. "We might end day one here," says Natalie Germanos. Some of South Africa's players are hanging around in the dugout. But it does not look promising.
